title: Travel exception is explicitly satisfied

units.rationale: The job reaches the candidate’s explicit 20% exception and meets its four-week notice condition.
required_points: Every trip has at least four weeks notice.
forbidden_inferences: Do not silently expand the exception beyond 20% or shorten notice.

units.rationale: Home-based with no required office days meets the hard location requirement.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer a right to work from any country.

units.rationale: Generic growth opportunities do not establish monthly protected learning time.
forbidden_inferences: Do not equate growth language with a protected time allocation.

critical_errors.description: Misreads Travel exception is explicitly satisfied: the learning preference or its cited role term.
Passing this role by ignoring the candidate’s explicit four-week-notice travel exception misreads pref_travel.

notes: Only the precise person-owned exception makes 20% travel acceptable here.
